summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Understanding and Meeting Customer Expectations. Equip yourself with essential strategies to delight your customers.
lede: Customer expectations training helps customer-facing professionals understand what customers value and align service promises with what can be delivered. Participants practise uncovering stated and unstated needs through listening and questions, mapping expectation gaps across customer journeys, and communicating delays or next steps clearly. The course also covers complaint conversations, service recovery, customer feedback, and turning expectations into practical service standards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly manage or respond to customer needs and expectations.
audience: Customer service representatives and contact center staff
Front office and branch staff in banks
Quality assurance or customer experience (CX) professionals
modules: Principles of Customer Expectations and Perception
Knowing Your Customer: Needs, Wants, and Priorities
Customer Journey Mapping and Expectation Hot Spots
Listening, Questioning, and Empathy Skills in Practice
Handling Complaints, Difficult Customers, and Service Recovery
Designing Service Standards Around Customer Expectations
Voice of the Customer: Feedback, Surveys, and Continuous Improvement
Cross-Functional Alignment: Keeping Promises Across the Organization
prerequisites: No prerequisites required. Ideal for professionals with customer-facing roles.
